# Farooqi Grammar School (FGS)

> Farooqi Grammar School is an established school in Lahore, Pakistan, providing affordable education from the early years through Matric, with a focus on academic achievement, character, discipline, confidence, and student development.

Farooqi Grammar School was founded in Lahore in 1978 by Sir Asim Farooqi and Madam Zahida Asim Farooqi. The school serves families through multiple Lahore campuses guided by shared academic standards and values.

## Key facts

- Official name: Farooqi Grammar School
- Common abbreviation: FGS
- Location: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded: 1978
- Education stages: Early years through Matric
- Campuses: Multiple campuses across Lahore
- Academic record: 47 Lahore Board Matric positions over 26 years
- Alumni: More than 50,000
- Educational approach: Academic excellence, affordable fees, discipline, character-building, confidence, and responsible student growth
- Technology: Technology and AI are used purposefully to support teaching and learning, not replace teachers
